basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from Peoria, Illinois, currently majoring in Computer Science. I'm passionate about gaming, particularly Roblox, where I spend most of my free time trading in-game items. I have a keen interest in Warhammer lore, especially Skaven. During the weekdays, I'm usually online in the evenings, but I have more flexible hours on weekends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with others who share similar interests in gaming and tech.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a moderate understanding of computer science concepts due to my coursework. I am mostly self-taught in gaming strategies and trading techniques on Roblox, which I learned through online forums and trial and error. Recently, I've been exploring cryptocurrency trading, as evidenced by my visits to NDAX.
